stories.title: U.S. stocks fall as oil surges and yields rise before key Treasury auction
stories.summary: U.S. stocks fell as oil prices surged and Treasury yields mostly rose. Investors turned cautious ahead of a closely watched Treasury auction.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising yields raise borrowing costs and pressure stock valuations, while higher oil adds inflation risk.

stories.title: Hormuz Strait transits fall to lowest in over two months after attacks
stories.summary: Shipping transits through the Strait of Hormuz dropped to their lowest level in more than two months, following recent attacks, according to data cited in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Hormuz is a critical oil chokepoint, so reduced transits signal supply risk and help explain the recent surge in oil prices.
